verdict.rationale: Evidence shows employees can quickly spin up new cards with approval workflows (ramp-comm-2) and that Ramp supports entity-level restrictions and dynamic approval routing (ramp-docs-14, ramp-docs-16), implying some granular control, but there is no explicit documentation of setting per-card numeric spend limits or category/merchant-level restrictions per employee. missing for 10: explicit docs on per-card spend limit configuration, merchant/category-level card controls, and independent verification of granularity.
